name: io.github.lewisdonovan/google-news
title: Google News
description: Search Google News, get top stories and read articles. No API key or headless browser.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_NEWS_THIRD_PARTY_APIKEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional SerpApi API key, used when Google rate-limits the scraper or instead of it

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_NEWS_THIRD_PARTY_PRIMARY
environmentVariables.description: "false" to scrape first and only use the API key as a fallback. Defaults to "true"
